# Performance Analytics

## Procedure
Track time since post, views vs engaged views, retention, viewed/swiped when available, subscribers per 1k engaged views, and actual realized revenue; recommend next measurable change.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
